CustomField.description: Whether this rung of the Call for Offers reminder ladder is currently in force. Lets an admin disable one rung (e.g. the day-of reminder) without deleting the record or breaking the {7, 3, 1, 0} data contract with Opportunity.Offer_Alert_Last_Interval__c.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Uncheck to disable this rung without deleting it.
CustomField.label: Is Active
